SPAST-associated corticospinal and other neurological dysfunction; spasticity alone does not establish primary muscle damage.
Epilepsy associated with a structural brain abnormality; underlying causes do not automatically add other axes.
Autoimmune CNS demyelination; optic neuritis directly damages the optic nerve in roughly 50-70% over the disease course and is a core diagnostic presentation.
